notes: The eight-control layout follows the G402-style DPI control arrangement; keep legacy writes disabled until captured from hardware.

Corrected 2026-09-17: expanded from 8 to 9 buttons. The official Logitech Getting Started guide's numbered feature diagram enumerates 6 special buttons (DPI increase, DPI decrease, a separate reprogrammable 'Generic Button 3', a separate default-DPI-reset button, Forward, Back) plus L/R/Middle = 9 total. The previous 8-button layout was missing the reprogrammable 'Generic Button 3' entirely -- it had folded DPI-area controls into only 3 slots where the real device has 4.
